evidence.state_available_before_decision: discovery/deep_article.raw: High-throughput single-cell control and Image analysis; linkage/deep_processors_code.raw:MotherFeedback.run_control/dispatch_handler; online processing then next frame strategy. Applies to controller, not automatically to offline arrays.

field_gaps.online_state_correspondence: metadata.json analysis_date is April 27-29 after April 13-24 acquisition. No native position/chamber/event-to-array map proves deposited arrays equal online feature stream.
field_gaps.sample_relation: Exported .npy same row is a logical longitudinal track. Native live mother lineage and chamber IDs, losses/replacements and imaging frame map absent.
field_gaps.two_measured_actions_per_question: Each mother/frame has one stims value; alternative is unobserved. Both 0 and 1 occur across experiments, not both potential responses for each decision. Different cells cannot be treated as the same question without exchangeability/interference evidence.
field_gaps.trusted_endpoint: GFP fluorescence is a legitimate gene-expression control reading, not terminal antibiotic survival or RNA expression. One-frame endpoint alignment is protocol-supported, actuation confirmation and unit calibration are missing.
field_gaps.matched_controls: Training acquisition code marks 400 reference chambers; deposited arrays lack reference IDs. All share chip/media, and neighbor_stims encodes optical neighborhood dependence.
field_gaps.known_qc: Arrays lack per-attempt acquisition, segmentation, focus, controller fallback and actuation success/failure ledger. Sharpness is a covariate, not passed QC.
field_gaps.costs_known: 60ms DMD and 85ms camera exposure and nominal 300s loop are settings, not total realized time/cost; state processing and illumination costs absent.
field_gaps.independence: Seven dated acquisitions; independent inoculum/culture/PDMS device and control component maps unverified. Mother cells/chambers not independent physical batches.
field_gaps.checkpoint: Fluorescence, bacteria and optical actions are outside registered STATE c39 X_hvg RNA drug contract; exact STATE training exposure unknown. Author forecasting networks are different models; no substitution.

field_gaps.costs: Actual acquisition/processing costs, durations and failure costs absent.
field_gaps.units: Raw Drug1Concentration has no unit column; preserve literal IDR microMolar annotation separately. No guessed unit conversion.

evidence.state_available_before_decision: linkage/yeast_online_code.raw:controlled phase ctrlRefOsc uses trackedCELLS from earlier frames, mvSRNGS before readIMG/tracking; no precise decision/availability timestamps.

field_gaps.online_state_correspondence: Published SingleCellTraces uses reverse segmentation and combines forward/reverse tracks; combine_cell_traces filters >=150 eventual frames, sorts by start. Online and offline identities not certified equivalent.
field_gaps.sample_relation: 193x500 feedback and 570x500 open-loop exported track arrays, with missing frames. Processed_data contains both online summaries and appended SingleCellTraces; do not conflate them.
field_gaps.actions: inputLEVELS has binary medium settings across time. Whole chamber receives one action per cycle; single cells do not supply simultaneous alternative actions for same chamber/state.
field_gaps.controls: Open-loop and feedback experiments are distinct acquisitions with different interventions; same question/menu exchangeability, independent cultures and matched controls not authenticated.
field_gaps.endpoint_QC: Reporter/cell-cycle summaries valid as observational readouts; export lacks complete attempt/failure ledger and source-specific QC. Eventual trace-length inclusion leaks future survival/trackability.
field_gaps.costs: Nominal 2 minute intervals are not actual processing availability or total acquisition/media/actuator costs.
field_gaps.checkpoint: Yeast reporter state and methionine media actions cannot enter current STATE RNA drug checkpoint; do not use author control outputs as STATE.

field_gaps.chronology: Unsynchronized imaging starts 20h before drug addition, 10min phase and 30min fluorescence intervals. Processing completion/decision availability not documented. Synchronized protocol adds drugs before imaging.
field_gaps.processing: fij.py uses average projection over full stacks and before/after concatenation; future frames can influence historical features. No certified prefix-only processing.
field_gaps.sample_relation: Trench IDs relate image channels in protocol; original acquisition native cell/lineage/channel-to-action records not deposited in inspected repo.
field_gaps.actions: Article describes two chemotherapies/concentrations; repo has analysis notebooks, example mask, no full raw track/attempt/control table for both actions. Notebook outputs are not execution receipts.
field_gaps.QC: Tracking losses and filtering discussed but full per-attempt reasons unavailable; no independent matched menus verified.
field_gaps.costs: No acquisition, processing or attempted-assay cost ledger.
field_gaps.checkpoint: Phase-contrast/PI/caspase features outside STATE X_hvg RNA input; unsupported drug/readout/context assumptions prohibited.
